title: fix(studio): show, keep and author a controlled-by-parent object's optional master
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1qmTvsS4RmPr4CF2WqFHpZ)_
Fixes #30974

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 现在认得「可选主字段」：OWD 总览把 `required: false` 的唯一主从字段显示为主对象；Studio 保存不再把作者写的 `required: false` 改成 `true`；字段检查器里唯一主从字段的「必填」可以取消（写成 `required: false`），下方说明无主记录只有所有者和「查看所有记录」可见。
- 为什么改：#30905 裁决 A 允许受父级控制对象的唯一主从字段可选，Studio 仍按「必须必填」处理，保存会悄悄改写作者选定的访问模型（p2）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `ui/packages/app-shell` 的 Studio 代码和一条 i18n 文案，不改 spec、不改运行时；回滚即还原本 PR。省略 `required` 的主字段仍按必填处理，两个以上主从字段时锁定照旧。
- 先看：`owd-sharing.ts`（主字段改由 spec 的 `controlledByParentMasterOf` 判定，保存只补省略的 `required`）、`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`（`cbpOptionalMasterAllowed` 一段）、`owd-sharing.test.ts`（被 #30940 改标的那一行翻回一致）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/owd-sharing.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 "one master without required" 与 "one optional master (required: false)" 两行都显示主对象 `crm_account`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0055 §1 as amended by #30905 ruling A lets a `controlled_by_parent` object's ONLY `master_detail` be declared `required: false`, an optional master whose records may name none. Studio still treated every master as required. This PR covers the card's three items:

- **Display** (`owd-sharing.ts`, `deriveMasterObject`). Which field is the master is now the spec's own answer, `controlledByParentMasterOf` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, so an optional master is shown as the master and the two-master shapes stay as the spec rules them (Studio does not re-decide them). An omitted `required` on the object's only `master_detail` is read as required first, as the spec's stored-row conversion `cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted` reads it, which is ruling A's "Studio still defaults it to required".
- **Save** (`owd-sharing.ts`, `requireCbpMasterDetails`, used by `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` and `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx`). Switching to Controlled by parent still sets `required: true` on each `master_detail` that writes no `required` (the builder's force), and now keeps an explicit `required: false`. The overview's 409 prerequisite list (`cbpPrerequisite`) reads the same predicate, `cbpMasterDetailDefaultsRequired`.
- **Authoring** (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`). On a cbp object's only `master_detail` the Required box is no longer locked on: clearing it writes `required: false` (never a dropped key, which would be defaulted back to required), and the help text under it, new key `designer.field.requiredCbpOptionalMaster` (en, zh), says a record that names no master is visible only to its owner and to View All Records on the object. Beside another `master_detail` the old lock and text stand, because the spec admits no optional master there (builder and `relationship/master-detail-required` refuse it).

## Why

Triage graded it p2: a Studio save silently turned an author's optional master into a required one, which rewrites the access model they chose.

## Tests

- The two display-agreement rows PR #30940 re-labelled flip back to agreement: "one master without required" in `owd-sharing.test.ts` and in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.cbpRequiredMaster-12326.test.tsx` now name `crm_account`, and the spec parse accepts the shape. The per-row "parses" override column is gone: every row's parse verdict now equals "a master is named".
- New rows: one optional master (`required: false`), a `required: false` master-detail beside the required one, two `master_detail` fields none required.
- New: `requireCbpMasterDetails` keeps an explicit `required: false` (map, array, and mixed with an omitted one); the overview save keeps it, through the rendered dial and Save button.
- Inspector, driven through the rendered checkbox: the only master-detail can be cleared to `required: false` and ticked back; beside another master-detail the box stays locked with the old reason.

Run on head 3c18a378 (the code head; f7f98072 after it changes only the changeset): the three files, 3/3 files, 38/38 tests passed.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; every restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

| Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|
| `deriveMasterObject` without the omitted-required default | 2 (both "one master without required" rows) |
| master judged by the old `required === true` count instead of `controlledByParentMasterOf` | 3 (both optional-master rows, the overview save test) |
| save predicate back to `required !== true` | 2 (both keeps-optional tests) |
| inspector commit back to `v \|\| undefined` | 2 |
| inspector lock back to `cbpMasterDetail && required === true` | 2 |
| inspector help text back to the old key | 1 |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The overview names the master but does not say whether it is optional; the inspector's help text is where the optional master is explained. No new overview string was added.
- A stored object whose only master omits `required` shows an unticked Required box (the box shows what is written), while the overview names it as the master. Ticking writes `required: true`; switching the model to Controlled by parent writes it too.
- `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` gets a comment-only edit: its comment said the save forces every `master_detail` required, which this change makes false.
- No `content/docs/frontend/` page describes the inspector's Required lock; the cbp docs belong to #30907.
